ADDENDUM <Rule No. 611, May 25, 2007>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Repeal of Other Statutes or Regulations)
The Rules on Criteria for Assessment of Administrative Fines under Article 112 (5) of the Special Act on the Jeju Free International City are hereby repealed.
